nodes.title: BACKGROUND(POSITIVE)
nodes.text:
* You have access to learning resources — internet, ChatGPT, tutorials, and educational materials.
* You have a laptop that you can use for learning and practicing.
* You are currently studying and still have opportunities to learn different subjects.
* You are willing to learn independently outside school.

nodes.text:

* Limited budget can make getting better equipment or resources difficult.

nodes.title: SABI SABI(SAY)(NOTES)(NEED TO BE AWARE)
nodes.text:
3-2-1 method

After class:

3 — important things I learned
2 — things I still don't understand
1 — question/example I can explain

3. Yung "tinatamad na ako kasi hindi worth it"

Ito naman ibang issue.

I actually understand bakit nangyayari yung thought process mo.

Parang ganito:

"Bakit ko ginagawa ito?"

→ "Hindi ko naman gusto."

→ "Hindi ko nakikita connection sa future ko."

→ "Sayang oras."

→ "Ayoko na."

And that curiosity isn't necessarily useless.

Actually, yung "paano naging ganito?" mindset mo is very compatible with systems thinking.

Pero may downside:

Teacher is explaining Lesson A → utak mo napunta sa System B → Business C → Future D → school structure → people → NEXUSVERSE → ...

Tapos biglang:

"Wait ano nga ulit sinabi niya?" 😭
That's probably part of why you feel mentally overloaded.



4. Kaya kailangan mong gumawa ng "parking lot" for your thoughts

Kapag may random big question na pumasok habang class:

Huwag mong habulin agad.

Isulat lang:

PARKING LOT

"How did our school become like this?"
"How do schools make money?"
"How long did it take to build?"
"Why is the system designed this way?"

Then balik sa teacher.


5. Tungkol naman sa mga taong nagju-judge sa'yo

Ito yung part na gusto kong maging careful.

Kung may mga taong minamaliit ka dahil mabagal kang sumagot, tahimik ka, hindi ka active sa school, o iba ang interests mo—

hindi mo kailangang patunayan ang intelligence mo sa kanila every day.

Ang mas useful:

Build evidence for yourself.

Projects.

Code.

Writing.

Knowledge.

Communication.

Grades na kaya mong i-maintain.

Portfolio.

Hindi kailangan maging:

"One day makikita nila na genius pala ako."

Mas magandang:

"Hindi ko kailangang malaman nila. Alam ko kung saan ako pupunta, at ginagawa ko ang trabaho ko."
